tools.name: vault_profile
tools.description: Return the stable API Vault profile represented by this authenticated connection. No provider credentials or internal owner identifiers are returned.

tools.name: vault_capabilities
tools.description: Describe API Vault's broker, autonomy modes, and credential boundary. Never returns stored credentials.

tools.name: vault_connections
tools.description: List API-key/PAT connections authorized to this connector. Safe metadata only; raw keys are never returned.

tools.name: vault_services
tools.description: List granular OAuth-connected service capabilities explicitly granted to this AI, including safe metadata for the user's bound repositories, projects, and other provider resources.

tools.name: vault_autonomy
tools.description: Show this AI's authority mode, provider-wide grants, user-owned connected resources, available provider surfaces (including dynamic Google API origins), and delegated browser profiles. Metadata only; no cookies, tokens, passwords, or provider secrets are returned.

tools.name: vault_models
tools.description: List AI models reachable through authorized API-key connections.

tools.name: vault_invoke_read
tools.description: Read data through an authorized API-key/PAT connection using a GET request. API Vault controls authentication and destination hosts and injects the stored credential server-side; credentials are never returned. Use vault_invoke_write for any operation that sends data or changes provider state.

tools.name: vault_invoke_write
tools.description: Execute a provider operation through an authorized API-key/PAT connection using a POST request, including AI model calls. Authentication and destination hosts are controlled by API Vault; the stored credential is injected server-side and never returned.

tools.name: vault_execute
tools.description: Execute one reviewed granular capability as the connected user, including approval-gated actions.

tools.name: vault_provider_read
tools.description: Read data through a full-provider or owner-equivalent grant on a registered provider API surface using a GET request. tools.name: vault_provider_write
tools.description: Change provider state through a full-provider or owner-equivalent grant on a registered provider API surface. tools.name: vault_browser_action
tools.description: Queue one structured action in a user-controlled authenticated browser profile. Browser cookies/session storage remain on the worker. Returns a job_id; call vault_browser_result until complete.

tools.name: vault_browser_result
tools.description: Read or consume the result of a previously queued API Vault browser job.

tools.name: vault_usage
tools.description: Read metadata-only API-key gateway usage for this connector.
